# systeam_service (Data Source)

Look up an existing service by name within an organization.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the service to look up.
- `organization_id` (Number) The organization the service belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The unique identifier of the service.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the service is active.
- `slug` (String) The service slug.
- `tier` (String) The service tier.
